title: Overlapping resonance branches of a gauge-invariant Lorentz-violating massive vector
summary: We investigate the propagation and resonance behavior of an Abelian massive vector field in the presence of a gauge-invariant, CPT-even, dimension-four Lorentz-violating kinetic operator constructed from a single preferred four-vector. In the massless theory, the propagator contains an additional algebraic pole that decouples from conserved currents, leaving two physical degrees of freedom. After spontaneous breaking of the internal U(1) symmetry, all three vector polarizations become physical but separate into two orthogonal dispersion branches carrying two and one physical polarization…
